title: Operator signature bytes discarded before group log append
description: reader/session/lifecycle.rs:475: sign_article signs the article, but the returned signature bytes are never extracted and passed to append_to_groups. The function always receives &[] as operator_signature. All group log entries record an empty signature, breaking the audit trail — log entries cannot be cryptographically verified against the article CID. Fix: extract the signature from the sign_article return value and thread it through to append_to_groups.
